title: Convert fonts from TTF to WOFF2 for smaller dist
description: 4 Inter TTF files total 1.3 MB (40% of dist). Converting to WOFF2 would cut to ~500 KB. Electron 39 uses Chromium ~135 which fully supports WOFF2.
resolution: All 4 Inter fonts converted from TTF to WOFF2 using ttf2woff2. globals.css updated with WOFF2 primary + TTF fallback. Font size reduced 65% (1.3MB → 453KB).
